_help: Wording and signatories printed on every corps certificate. Edit this file and restart the server. To add the NYSC logo, save it as backend/assets/certificate/nysc-logo.png. For each signatory, save the signature image (PNG, transparent background) next to this file and put its file name in 'signature'. Leave 'name' empty to print only a signature line and the title.
heading: Certificate of Completion
body: has successfully completed the EPHAAG Farms training programme for National Youth Service Corps members.
